title: AO/RFP Writer - Fixed Income
description:
**Job Description**
*AllianceBernstein’s Client Group has a presence in the Americas, Europe, Asia and Australia, and is composed of five main areas:*

* Sales & Client Services works with financial intermediaries and institutions to offer diversified investment solutions that help clients build and preserve their wealth
* Business Development is a conduit to the firm’s investment teams and supports our clients and internal business partners through investment-platform and product content, messaging, competitive analysis and education
* Product Strategy & Development designs, develops and manages the firm’s global lineup of investment services and considers clients’ evolving needs to identify new opportunities
* Marketing promotes the firm and its services by creating, packaging and distributing content and messaging to engage diverse audiences through digital platforms and initiatives, strategic campaigns, and events
* Business Transformation looks to evolve and scale our business, leveraging digital and data, to drive top-line growth and improve profitability

**What You’ll Do**
*AllianceBernstein’s Request for Proposal (RFP) team is in search of a RFP writer to contribute to business development and client service through the completion of RFPs, RFIs, as well as some due diligence requests for AllianceBernstein’s Fixed Income Strategies. The Writer will specialize in writing RFPs for our Fixed Income Strategies in a timely and accurate manner, while also contributing, where needed, to the completion of other projects and requests. The Writer will be expected to be able to work effectively with the firm’s Senior RFP Writers and Management Team, Product Managers and Portfolio Managers, as well as our Sales Teams, to write and maintain (keep updated) original and technical product-specific content to support our Fixed Income platform, and, importantly, to be able to effectively customize that content for specific sales situations as needed.*
*This position will provide an opportunity to develop knowledge in the entire new business development process: from the initial screening of an RFP, to the organization and project management of an RFP, to the actual content creation and updating of RFP language and then, finally, to the follow-up and tracking of our RFPs. The candidate will be expected to handle a high volume of requests simultaneously and productively. Projects will be primarily related to new business opportunities, as well as some client servicing-related including Onboarding Questionnaires and client Due Diligence Questionnaires.*
**Specific Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Write a high volume of RFPs for Fixed Income strategies and support other asset classes as needed.
* Liaise with various departments throughout the firm to collect information needed to respond to requests, including but not limited to portfolio management, product management/marketing, legal, operations, AUM reporting and performance.
* Create and maintain RFP language and content for assigned strategies of coverage, including investment process, research process, team information, and competitive advantages.
* Maintain consistent product messaging and updated product language in our RFP database.
* Collaborate directly with Product Managers, Portfolio Managers, Research Analysts, Traders, and others to update existing RFP language and develop new language.
* Customize final documents to reflect a nuanced and targeted response to the specific sales opportunity.
* Handle follow-up work associated with RFPs moving to the next phase: coordinating answers, additional information, etc.
* Oversee production of final proposals (formatting, technical editing and reproduction).
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously to meet strict deadlines.
* Field ad-hoc questions from our Client Response Center Team daily, as needed.

**What We’re Looking For**
*The ideal candidate should have:*

* Knowledge of the broader fixed income market and the asset management industry.
* Detail-oriented with excellent project management and organizational skills; able to prioritize work and handle multiple tasks to ensure that complex projects are completed by deadline, with interim review steps incorporated.
* Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills as well as the ability to work independently and as part of a team in a large global organization.
* Demonstrated desire and ability to learn technical info, including philosophy, research and investment processes of our products.
* Demonstrated initiative and good judgment as well as the ability to work well under pressure and with time constraints.
* Interest in and ability to interact directly and effectively with Sales Advisors, Portfolio Managers and other investment professionals.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Word, and possess the ability to quickly master internal systems and applications.
* Experience: 5-8 years of RFP and industry experience required. Direct experience with Fixed Income RFP content is required.
* Education: CFA Level I cleared & MBA Finance

**About AB**
*We are a leading global investment management firm offering high-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work.*
*Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us!*

title: FAAS - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – Assurance FAAS – Manager – Controllership Transformation (Core)**
**The opportunity**
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provides advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support. Within EY FAAS practice, the Finance Transformation Experts team build and develop client relationship with our regional stakeholders. We are part of an integrated global network of professionals who develop, design and optimise client service business processes for efficiency and high performance. We leverage and improve various frameworks, methodologies, solutions specific to our offerings and articulate presentations that communicate proposals, strategies, plans and outcomes.
  
  
**Qualification Requirement**

* CA, MBA (Finance) with Commerce Background, CWA, CMA, CFA, M.Com

**Job Responsibilities**
**Technical, Delivery & Subject Matter Areas**

* The primary focus of the role is using deep techno functional knowledge to drive transformation in any or all record to report areas which may not necessarily involve any technology implementation. The role is not focused on hands on technology implementation rather driving transformation in record to report areas holistically as a transformation lead (not PMO).
* Deep end to end techno functional knowledge on record to report data structure & how record to report process flows end to end in leading ERP solutions like SAP FI,CO, COPA, Closing Cockpit, SAP BPC, SAP Group Reporting, SAP FI/CO integration with SAP MM, SAP SD, SAP PP, Oracle Fusion Financial etc) transforming record to report process areas of i) Revenue Recognition ii) Accurals iii) Intercompany reconciliation iv) Manual Journal Entries & their automation v) Asset Accounting vi) Chart of Accounts & Accounting Master Data vii) Account reconciliation in the areas of cash & bank, sales, etc viii) Sub ledger accounting ix) Consolidation process x) Production & filing of financial statements xi) Notes & disclosures to accounts. Xii) Cost Accounting & Inventory xiii) Profitability Analysis
* Provide Subject matter expertise & lead delivery teams in Record to report transformation/Implementation in process areas mentioned above.
* Deep techno-functional knowledge of ERP platform integration with AI based technologies. Hands on experience of designing AI solution for record to report areas based on SAP platform.
* Intensive knowledge of consolidation process and how consolidation data structure is set up & how consolidation process runs in leading consolidation tool like SAP Group Reporting, SAP BPC, Oracle FCCS etc & how operational chart of accounts are mapped to Group Chart of Accounts in BPC or FS Items in SAP Group Reporting
* Lead delivery teams or workstream in large projects for a one or more solution areas.
* Solid knowledge of AI solutions availability & applicability in record to report area. Knowledge & experience of AI solutions development in record to report area is preferred.

**Business Development & Solution Development Areas**

* Lead pursuit teams to understand client problem statements & formulate that in solutions
* Lead developing client specific solutions for the engagement team
* Lead proposal building or lead proposal teams
* Lead collaboration with market teams to develop relationship to secure more business for EY
* Collaborate cross service lines to ensure smooth execution of the project.
* Lead development of internal capability development and lead training sessions to coach internal teams to develop capability
* Lead operational initiatives within the practice areas

**People Management Areas**

* Directly manage team of 5-8 FTEs in one or more solution areas.
* Develop people through coaching, motivation & guided training
* Develop career path & have career conversations with FTEs to keep them engaged.

**Skills**
**Subject Matter & Technical Skills & Knowledge**

* Deep knowledge in Record to report, invoice to pay and Order to cash areas
* Certification and/or sound experience based knowledge in ERPs like SAP S/4 HANA FI/CO/COPA, SAP Central Finance, Oracle Fusion Finance, Oracle Netsuite
* Certification and/or sound experience based knowledge in digital finance solutions like Blackline, Trintech, High Radius, Different RPA solutions
* Knowledge about AI/ML/Gen-AI & Analytics solution in finance space particularly in Record to Report areas.
* Knowledge of consolidation, reporting, inter-company and ERP data structures
* Have experience in current state analysis (As is), future state analysis (To be), process optimization, data optimization, data analytics, data management

**Business Skills & Knowledge**

* Strong business development skills
* Very strong solution conceptualization/ideation skill
* Strong olution/product build skills
* Strong project management skills

**Human Skills**

* Excellent written & oral communication & articulation
* Flexible work attitude
* Proven ability to lead diverse team over multiple geographies
* Strong collaboration skills
* Ability to comprehend complexity quickly & apply solutions
* Comfort in dealing with ambiguity
* Strond entrepreneurial skills in terms of ownership of problem & solutions
* Strong problem solving skills
* Ability to work under stress & produce results
* Willingness to travel for short or long duration at short notice

**Experience Requirement & Profile**

* 7-10 Years of relevant consulting experience in record to report transformation (not Industry user experience)
* Experience of working with international clients preferred
* Experience with previous multinational consulting firms or Big4 firms

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr Financial Systems Analyst
description:
HMH is a learning technology company committed to delivering connected solutions that engage learners, empower educators and improve student outcomes. As a leading provider of K–12 core curriculum, supplemental and intervention solutions, and professional learning services, HMH partners with educators and school districts to uncover solutions that unlock students’ potential and extend teachers’ capabilities.
  
  
HMH serves more than 50 million students and 4 million educators in 150 countries. For more information, visit www.hmhco.com
  
  
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sr Financial Systems Analyst within the FP&A department with proven expertise in Power BI to lead data integration from Anaplan and other data sources, data transformation and modeling, and dashboarding. You will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing innovative solutions to drive financial performance and operational efficiency within our organization, while discovering new reporting and analysis to present to internal partners.
  
  
Under the supervision of the Manager, Financial Systems, who is also responsible for the Anaplan tool within FP&A, you will also perform administrative tasks within Anaplan related to data integrations, data validation, hierarchy management, etc.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Model Design and Optimization: Design, build, and optimize Power BI models to support complex financial analyses via self-service access for our stakeholders
* Data Integration and Governance: Establish robust data integration processes to ensure seamless data flows between Power BI and other financial systems, while maintaining data integrity and governance standards.
* Performance Tuning and Scalability: Optimize Power BI performance and scalability by implementing best practices in model architecture, calculation logic, and data management techniques.
* User Training and Enablement: Provide comprehensive training and support to end-users, empowering them to leverage Power BI effectively for decision-making, analysis, and reporting purposes.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate closely with key stakeholders across Finance, IT, and Business Operations to gather requirements, define solutions, and drive alignment on Power BI implementation strategies. This can mean self-identifying projects and presenting new, unanticipated, functionality within Power BI
* Continuous Improvement: Stay abreast of Power BI updates, industry trends, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for process improvements, enhancements, and innovation.

**What You’ll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Computer Science, or related field. Advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., Power BI certifications, Anaplan certifications, CMA) preferred.
* Proven experience using Power BI, with a strong track record of designing and implementing scalable Power BI solutions in complex organizational environments.
* Expertise in Power BI model building, including blueprinting, module design, formula creation, and dashboard development.
* Deep understanding of financial concepts and FP&A processes, with the ability to translate business requirements into actionable Power BI solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail and a passion for driving data-driven decision-making.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage multiple priorities, and drive projects to successful completion within defined timelines.
* Prior experience in consulting and/or leading projects is a plus.
* Experience in the education industry is a plus.

The Information Technology organization is transforming to realize our mission: Become a leader in HMH’s digital transformation, and as a strategic partner, innovate and deliver highest value, competitive advantage solutions across all corporate and business functions. Our ambition is to be a digital leader through innovation and develop and deliver leading edge technology such as robotic process automation and artificial intelligence to solve some of HMH’s greatest operational business challenges. Our professionals will have business relevant skills to connect our HMH partners to technologies that propel the businesses to deliver the greatest value for HMH and our customers.
  
  
We are building a team of IT professionals with an insatiable appetite to learn, a relentless focus on customer service, a technological curiosity toward future possibilities, and a creativity in solving business challenges with leading technologies. Our team will find ways to work together, create a sense of community where it’s safe to take risks and learn together, develop our careers, and all have an opportunity to work on new technologies. We will work together, learn together and have fun together. As a team, we will lead HMH’s digital transformation.

title: Senior Consultant, FinOps Strategy, Governance & Value Realization
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
he GTDA FinOps Strategy, Governance & Value Realization team sits at the intersection of technology, business, and finance. The team partners across Cloud Engineering, Product Engineering, Platform Engineering, Finance, and business leadership to improve cost transparency, capacity planning, optimization accountability, and investment value realization. Its mission is to build strategy ,trusted reporting, governance standards, and decision-ready insights that help TransUnion manage cloud infrastructure & AI spend more effectively while enabling sustainable technology growth. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
The Senior Consultant, FinOps Strategy, Governance & Value Realization is a senior individual contributor role responsible for advancing TransUnion’s cloud and AI economics, infrastructure cost transparency, capacity planning, and value realization capabilities
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
are the main areas of ownership for the role. For this role, I’d summarize them as:
  
  

* Cloud /AI infrastructure Cost Reporting: Own trusted reporting for cloud, AI, and on-prem infrastructure spend across leadership levels.
* Capacity Planning & Utilization Analysis: Consolidate demand signals, analyze usage trends, and support forward-looking capacity decisions.
* Optimization Pipeline & Value Realization: Manage cost optimization opportunities from identification through Finance-validated realization.
* FinOps Governance & Standards: Build governance processes, playbooks, RACIs, reporting standards, and escalation models.
* Federated FinOps Enablement: Support embedded FinOps leaders with training, data packages, benchmarks, and consistent operating practices.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Partner with engineering, finance, and business stakeholders to drive decisions, accountability, and cost ownership.

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

* Experience in cloud financial management, infrastructure capacity planning, IT finance, enterprise reporting, or a closely related analytical discipline.
* Advanced understanding of cloud and business capacity planning, with a strong track record in performance analysis and executive-level reporting.
* Advanced knowledge of public cloud platforms — GCP and/or AWS — including savings plans, committed-use discounts, reservations, tagging strategies, and resource lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in Google BigQuery for querying, modeling, and analyzing cloud cost and usage datasets at scale.
* Deep, hands-on understanding of enterprise infrastructure including server, storage, network, virtualization (VMware), database, middleware, and common operating systems.
* Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for reporting and executive communication; hands-on experience with cloud cost tooling such as Harness CCM strongly preferred.
* Experience building and owning capacity utilization reporting across storage, server, VMware, database, and network infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and interpret usage statistics, develop forward-looking capacity projections, and validate assumptions with stakeholders.
* Proven ability to work independently and lead complex analytical workstreams in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities.
* Strong influencing and communication skills — able to translate complex infrastructure and cost data into clear recommendations and executive narratives.
* Experience mentoring or guiding junior analysts or consultants.
* The ability to socialize ideas, build cross-functional consensus, and drive decisions in a matrixed or federated organization.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* FinOps Foundation certification (FOCP or equivalent) or equivalent demonstrated expertise in FinOps operating models.
* Scripting or automation skills — VBA, PowerShell, SQL, or Python — with a track record of building reporting automation that reduces manual effort.
* Experience with Splunk or similar observability/analytics platforms for infrastructure performance analysis.
* Experience integrating cloud /AI economics data into enterprise financial planning workflows including forecasting, budgeting, chargeback/showback, and savings recognition.
* Experience designing or operating within a federated or matrixed technology organization across cloud engineering, product engineering, and finance functions.
* Familiarity with JIRA, ServiceNow/Remedy, or similar workflow systems for optimization tracking and work-item routing.
* Experience with AI/ML or GPU infrastructure economics and governance.
* Background in cloud cost automation, anomaly detection, or agent-based FinOps tooling

**TransUnion Overview**
At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our
**Workforce for Good**
, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.
  
  
Be a part of our
**Workforce for Good**
– you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

Sr Consultant, Strategic Planning

title: EYP-DM-Associate Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**GDS EY-P – S&E – Standalone, One-time & Stranded Costing – Associate Manager – India**
Within EY-P, S&E team services clients with a full range of hands-on, operationally focused support and advice across the transaction life cycle, across buyers and sellers. We cover a wide range of operational aspects, including divestiture advisory services, carve-out readiness and support, operational due diligence, synergy assessment and delivery, day-one readiness assessment, 100-day planning, integration process support, carve-out/stand-alone costs assessment and risks, and cost reduction.
  
  
Our professionals work on transactions and business development across the globe.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for Associate Managers with 6–8 years of experience in M&A life cycle, carve-out / integration of a business post-announcement of transaction, cross-border M&A who specialize in Standalone Cost Models, Stranded Cost Models, and One-time costs. This role sits within EY Parthenon Deal Management’s Standalone Costing (SAC) Centre of Excellence (CoE), which is the global hub for delivering all standalone, stranded, and one time cost analyses across transactions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Demonstrate excellent skills in developing and implementing standalone cost models, stranded cost models, and one-time cost projections following carve-out, spins and Integrations
* Develop and apply functional cost and headcount benchmarks using third‑party datasets to validate future‑state standalone assumptions
* Identify and quantify cost, dis‑synergy, and entanglement risks impacting standalone EBITDA and deal valuation
* Classify costs into various functional heads using trial balance and further classifying into direct vs allocated costs and headcount vs non headcount costs
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure effective management and optimization of standalone projects, stranded assets, and one-time expenditures
* Build strong relationships with EY offices across the globe, demonstrating knowledge of regional practices and contributing to client satisfaction
* Support business development activities by providing expertise on standalone cost models, stranded cost models, and one-time cost considerations
* Provide guidance to project teams and mentor junior professionals, fostering their growth and development within the CoE
* Conduct timely performance reviews for employees and develop other professionals by providing effective performance feedback and training. Lead by example
* Identify business development opportunities and assist Partners and Senior Managers on proposals and new business opportunities
* Leverage and enhance AI‑driven tools and tech enablement solutions across standalone, stranded, and one‑time cost modelling, including refining prompt libraries, improving automation outputs, and supporting the continuous enhancement of AI services used within SAC engagements

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Good understanding of M&A life cycle, carve-out / integration of a business post-announcement of transaction, cross-border M&A
* Possess financial analysis experience from a number of pre- and post-deal transactions, with the ability to link detailed operational analysis to P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet
* Understanding of corporate allocations and methodology to replace allocated costs
* Skill to synthesize approaches to complex carve-out and integration conflicts
* Talent to adapt to new challenges and ideas
* Excellent problem solving, project management, facilitation, and interpersonal skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Strong executive presence with good networking and negotiation skills

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Post Graduate degree in business, accounting, finance, engineering, computer science, or related field from a premier institute with 6-8 years of applicable industry and/or consulting experience
* Understanding of M&A life cycle, carve-out / integration of a business post-announcement of transaction, cross-border M&A with specialized knowledge of standalone costs, stranded costs, and one-time costs
* Proficiency in Excel‑based financial and cost modelling, with the ability to translate outputs into executive‑ready PowerPoint materials
* Willingness to undertake international travel as per business requirement

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills
* Effective communication and presentation skills

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY-P practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We will introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

description:

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.
  
  
**Job Description**
Team Name: Incentives
  
  
Job Title: F&A Senior Officer
  
  
Grade: 09
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Incentive F&A Senior Officer is responsible for calculating or auditing Contractual payouts or Incentive adjustment refunds for any amounts owed to the customer. He/ She must be highly proficient in using MS Access and Excel and should have strong process knowledge. Additionally, he/she will be responsible for communicating information and clarification to site Management team, Senior Leadership, Customer, Pricing, F&A, Business Development, and Brokerage team.
  
  
**Job Duties**

* Identifies specific issue with weekly and deferred incentives.
* Communicate with Customer, Business Development, Brokerage and Revenue Management Team.
* Updates the management team on the status of the worked done on daily basis.
* Increase in velocity of Enterprise Incentive adjustment.
* Knowledge of Advance excel and Access to handle critical data.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Proper coordination and continuous follow up with stake holders.
* Good communication skills, written and verbal.
* Works with internal and external customers to ensure incentive issue is resolved.
* Calculates and processes incentive rebates to remedy the impact of the identified incentive issue.
* Explains in detail the calculation methodology to the sales force so they can present to the customer.
* Calculates/ Audits estimated future deferred incentive obligations based on current volume/revenue data.
* Monitors and maintains timing of accrual reversals to coincide with payments.
* Explains significant variances in accruals and payments.
* Controls and assigns incoming incentive contracts.
* Creates various journals for the General Ledger.
* Manages vendor number requests.
* Calculates various special projects.
* Imports and balances TSOA accrual information.
* Should be able to deliver in challenging situations.

**Prerequisite**

* Bachelor’s Degree – Finance & Accounting (preferred).
* Eye for detail and should meet stiff deadlines.
* Have an excellent attendance track record.
* Self-Driven.
* Strong Customer Orientation, understanding customer services issues.
* Incentive process knowledge is mandatory.

* Once the employee is selected for the position, he/she cannot cancel the job transfer.
* If the employee who has been selected has any pre-approved leaves for the later months, then it must be approved again by the new team Supervisor/Manage.

Permanent

title: Sr. Manager-Real Estate Operations & Country Controlling
description:

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**Real Estate Operations and Country Controlling**

Exposure to complex IFRS 16 and lease-accounting activities.
  
  
Opportunity to lead a sizeable operational team and collaborate with multiple stakeholders.

Advanced application of IFRS 16 and lease-accounting principles in an operational environment.

title: Process Specialist Product Cost Calculation Tool & Premises
description:
**Scope & Purpose**
Global administration, training and support for continuous improvement of MAHLE’s Product Cost Calculation tool FACTON and the related Premises Planning processes. Key responsibilities include managing the FACTON costing platform, ensuring process compliance and data quality, providing user support and training, driving standardization and system enhancements, and coordinating global premises planning to enable accurate and transparent product costing.
  
  
**Your Contribution**

* Quotation & PDP Product Cost Calculation Tool Administration, Training and support for Continuous Improvement
* Focus on FACTON Software Tool for PDP Product Cost Calculation
* Conduct quality reviews and global audits to ensure compliance with MAHLE standards and accuracy of cost data
* Provide 1st level support for FACTON users incl. solving tickets
* Escalate problems to IT or FACTON or GPO Programs & Project Controlling
* Further development of MAHLE standards & processes (e.g. new releases) & collaboration with FACTON for implementation of new features incl. Testing (e.g. reports)
* Support the development of training material for Key Users
* Training of Key Users / FACTON Users
* Lead and develop FACTON User Community by establishing best practices and providing continuous knowledge sharing
* Premises Planning Process for Product Calculations
* Support and further development of Process & Method for Premises Planning
* Organization and moderation of kick-off- and alignment meetings incl. preparation
* Premises file preparation for plants and management of data sharing
* Tracking data provision by plant and data analysis & feedback; Support Plant CO (Q&A)
* Consolidation of plant data and visualization of contents (e.g. via PowerBI)
* Documentation and Presentation generation
* Content definition (Guidance) and Creation of Manual for the premises planning
* FACTON administration & upload of premises
* Conducting adjustments and updates during the year

**Your Experience And Qualification**

* Successfully completed degree in Business Administration or a comparable field of study.
* Several years of professional experience in Product Cost Calculation for customer projects in the Product Development Process (PDP), strong system knowledge in FACTON or in a comparable product costing tool.
* Experience in defining assumptions and parameters for product cost calculations (e.g., labor rates, machine rates, and overhead costs).

**Minimum Requirement**

* Strong computer skills, particularly SAP (CO-PC), as well as advanced MS Office skills, especially PowerPoint, Excel and PowerBI.
* Strong communication skills: to effectively convey information to stakeholders and internal customers. Fluent written and spoken English.
* High level of process, standardization, and efficiency orientation and attention to detail paired with a pragmatic and hands-on approach.
* Problem-solving and analytical skills: to identify issues and develop effective solutions.
* Solution-oriented mindset with a strong focus on quality, compliance, and internal customer satisfaction.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Proactive and forward-thinking mindset.
* Responsible and organized, logical thinker.
* Passion to learn new concepts, technologies, and processes.
* Willingness to travel.

**Our Offering**
We will provide a collaborative environment working on exciting assignments, along with ongoing personal & career development opportunities.
  
  
We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!
  
  
After receiving your online application, the interview process will typically be, once your profile gets shortlisted.

with our inclusive culture, we welcome applications from all social, religious & ethnical backgrounds, disabilities both mental and physical, identities (gender) and neurodivergent people.

title: Fund Accounting Analyst
description:
The Fund Accounting Analyst is an entry level position responsible for assisting in a variety of fund valuation activities in coordination with the Operations - Transaction Services team. The overall objective of this role is to assist in the calculation of daily and periodic Net Asset Valuations (NAVs) for funds and the distribution of associated unit prices.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Monitor the work activities to ensure timeliness/accuracy of the funds activities in a department, including calculation of NAV and distribution factors
* Assist in reviewing stock and cash reconciliations as a Checker to ensure the exceptions noted have no NAV impact and items cleared are treated correctly
* Ensure corporate actions are correctly reflected on the NAV
* Assist in handling complex issues
* Facilitate prompt investigation and resolution of any client queries in a timely and professional manner
* Ensure client Service Level Agreement (SLA) and deadlines are met
* Assist in the collection and analysis of relevant management information from an operational and client perspective
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Independently apply judgement in managing day-to-day responsibilities, including assessing complex situations, resolving issues, and determining appropriate courses of action. Will be responsible for decisions and outcomes within area of responsibility, leveraging professional expertise and analytical thinking to address challenges and ensure delivery of work to defined quality and performance expectations.
* Support effective functioning of the business area by ensuring that administrative processes are implemented consistently and outputs meet expected standards. Will operate across varied and evolving situations, responding to operational requirements to ensure continuity, quality, and timely delivery of work.
* Applies domain expertise and advanced analytical capability to deliver outputs aligned with established standards and professional benchmarks. Will evaluate business requirements by analyzing complex issues, forming well‑reasoned views, and recommending practical, implementable solutions. Apply structured thinking, analytical rigor, and creativity in approaching work, particularly in situations where standard methodologies may require refinement. Will exercise sound professional judgement in interpreting requirements and determining appropriate courses of action, taking into account the broader business context and potential implications.

**Qualifications:**

* Relevant experience preferred
* Experience in accounting, finance, or business-related area
* Experience within Financial Services or Operations
* MBA graduates, CFA certification or Chartered Accountants preferred
* Proven experience in funds administration
* Knowledge of funds services and processes

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

title: CA Industrial Trainee
description:
**Job Description**
Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, Depend®, and Kimberly-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly-Clark, it’s all here for you—innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes a certain kind of person and teams who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your professional expertise, talent, and drive to building and managing our portfolio of iconic, ground-breaking brands. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.
  
  
**About You**
You perform at the highest level possible, and you appreciate a performance culture fueled by authentic caring. You want to be part of a company actively dedicated to sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development.
  
  
In one of our professional roles, you’ll focus on winning with consumers and the market, while putting safety, mutual respect, and human dignity at the center.
  
  
To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:
  
  
**Management Reporting & Presentations**

* Develop presentations, dashboards, and governance reports for management and leadership discussions.
* Analyze information from multiple sources and synthesize insights into clear and actionable updates.

**Risk & Controls Advisory**

* Support risk and controls assessments across business processes, transformation initiatives, and organizational changes.
* Contribute to root cause analysis, issue remediation, and risk mitigation activities for identified control matters.

**Remediation & Issue Management**

* Support tracking of remediation plans for control gaps and audit observations, including review of supporting documentation and closure evidence.
* Prepare status updates, key insights, and management reports on remediation progress and related risks.

**Transformation & Strategic Initiatives**

* Support governance, risk, and controls activities for business transformation, ERP implementation, and process improvement initiatives.
* Assist in identifying and assessing risks arising from process, system, and organizational changes.

**Global Stakeholder Engagement**

* Collaborate with global process owners, finance teams, project teams, and assurance partners on controls and governance matters.
* Participate in cross-functional discussions and support strategic and adhoc requests related to risk, controls, and transformation activities.

**Eligibility**

* CA student eligible for Industrial Training under ICAI guidelines.
* Strong academic performance
* Articleship experience in Internal Audit, Risk Advisory, Statutory Audit, SOX, Process Consulting, or related areas preferred. Experience with a leading consulting, audit, or professional services firm is an advantage

**Skills & Competencies**
**Mandatory**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills.
* Analytical and structured problem-solving ability.
* Understanding of risk, governance, and internal control concepts.
* Ability to synthesize information and present insights clearly.

**Preferred**

* Exposure to Internal Audit, Risk Advisory, or SOX engagements.
* Understanding of finance and business processes such as RTR, STP, OTC.
* Exposure to SAP or other ERP systems.

**What You Will Gain**

* Exposure to a global controls and governance environment.
* Opportunity to work with stakeholders across multiple countries and functions.
* Experience supporting transformation and process improvement initiatives.
* Practical understanding of risk management, issue remediation, and governance.
* Development of communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Led by Purpose. Driven by You.**

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our recruiting team will review your application and follow up if you seem like a great fit for this role.
  
  
In the meantime, please check out the careers website.

For Kimberly-Clark to grow and prosper, we must be an inclusive organization that applies the diverse experiences and passions of its team members to brands that make life better for people all around the world, which is why we seek to build a workforce that encompasses the experiences of our consumers.  When you bring your original thinking to Kimberly-Clark, you fuel the continued success of our enterprise. title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst (Healthcare)
description:
**About Us**
Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.
  
  
As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.
  
  
Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst (Healthcare) to join our Growth Analytics team. This role is ideal for a data professional with 4–5 years of experience who is passionate about turning healthcare data into decisions that drive revenue.
  
  
You will be the analytics engine behind our go-to-market motion. You will build the AI-assisted dashboards, forecasts and models that tell leadership where the pipeline stands, where margin is made, and where the next opportunity is. You will also provide hands-on sales operations support to the Sales Director team.
  
  
Success in this role looks like dashboards and analysis that leaders rely on, a trusted reputation as the go-to partner for sales and growth analytics, and the ability to turn complex healthcare data into clear, compelling narratives. You will thrive if you bring curiosity, learning agility and a proactive approach in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  
  
**Your Day to Day**
**Growth analytics and business intelligence**

* Design, build and maintain AI-assisted dashboards, KPIs and executive reporting in BI tools (Power BI or Tableau), SQL and Excel to track pipeline, bookings, revenue and sales performance
* Use AI and agentic tools to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting and data preparation, and generate insights and narrative summaries, applying human judgment to validate accuracy before anything reaches leadership
* Analyze pipeline, historical and real-time data to surface trends, develop forecasts, and inform pipeline and revenue planning
* Build revenue, cost and deal-margin models, and support pricing analysis for our healthcare data products
* Prepare the data, analytics and demo materials that showcase our payment integrity, medical cost management, value-based care, population health, risk adjustment and HEDIS/Star offerings
* Provide data and analysis for RFPs and proposals so that every number holds up to scrutiny
* Track payer, market, competitor and regulatory trends, and translate findings into actionable insights for Sales, Product and executive leadership
* Ensure data accuracy and consistency across systems, reports and dashboards

**Sales operations support**

* Maintain CRM documentation and data hygiene, and troubleshoot CRM and tooling issues
* Support weekly sales calls and pipeline reviews
* Assist the Sales Director team with demo environments, sales collateral, and ad hoc deal and account analytics
* Create executive presentations and sales decks with clear, data-driven narratives
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Finance and GTM teams on analysis and strategy

**What You Bring To The Team**

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in analytics, business intelligence, consulting or sales operations
* 2–3+ years working in US healthcare or healthcare data/analytics (payer, provider, vendor, health-tech or consulting)
* Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience building dashboards in a BI tool such as Power BI or Tableau
* Hands-on experience using AI and agentic AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot) to build, automate or accelerate analytics and reporting work, with sound judgment about validating AI-generated output
* Advanced Excel proficiency
* Baseline financial and business acumen: comfortable with unit economics, margin, pricing and financial reporting
* Ability to synthesize data into insights and executive-ready communication, both written and verbal
* Demonstrated learning agility, problem-solving ability and attention to detail
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Analytics or a related field

**What We Would Like To See, But Not Required**

* Familiarity with payer claims data, healthcare financial concepts or payment integrity
* Experience reporting from a CRM such as Salesforce or HubSpot
* Experience building or configuring AI agents, automated workflows or integrations (for example via MCP, APIs or low-code tools)
* Exposure to cloud data platforms and modern data stack tools

**What You’ll Get In Return**

* Competitive leave and benefits
* Comprehensive health coverage
* Equity for every employee – share in our success
* Growth-focused environment – your development matters here

**Work Arrangements**

* Standard hours: 9 hours/day, 5 days/week
* Location: Remote; must be able to work U.S. hours (Eastern Time)
* Shift: This role requires alignment with U.S. business hours (Eastern Time) to support the Growth Analytics and Sales leadership teams in real time. Specific working hours may vary based on business needs.

**Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer**
As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. Therefore, we dedicate resources to building diverse teams and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. Abacus prohibits discrimination and harassment regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
At the heart of who we are is a commitment to continuously and intentionally building an inclusive culture—one that empowers every team member across the globe to do their best work and bring their authentic selves. We carry that same commitment into our hiring process, aiming to create an interview experience where you feel comfortable and confident showcasing your strengths. If there’s anything we can do to support that—big or small—please let us know.
  
  
**AI Use in Recruitment**
We use AI-powered tools throughout our recruitment process. This includes Greenhouse's Real Talent Matching Technology, which helps prioritize applications based on job-related criteria, as well as additional AI tools used to support sourcing, interview preparation, and other recruiting tasks.
**We do not remove the human element—our recruiters and hiring teams review all applications and make all decisions related to candidate progression and hiring, regardless of which tools are used to support that process.**
**Identity and Location Verification**
To protect the integrity of our hiring process, all interviews are conducted by live video with your camera on. Virtual or blurred backgrounds and headsets are not permitted absent an approved accommodation, and you should be in a well-lit, private space where your face and surroundings are clearly visible. Candidates who advance may also be asked to complete identity and location verification, which may include verifying your identity, work history, and confirming that you are located where your application states. Applications containing knowingly false or materially misrepresented information, including identity, location, or credentials, may be disqualified, and any offer may be rescinded if a material misrepresentation is discovered at any point in the process.
  
  
If you need an accommodation for any part of the interview process, please let your recruiter know in advance.
  
  
By applying, you acknowledge that we will collect and process your personal information for recruiting purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including for the verification steps described above. Please review our Applicant Privacy Notice for more information, including your rights.

title: Process Improvement Leader - R2R (Record to Report)
description:
Job Title
  
  
Process Improvement Leader - R2R (Record to Report)
  
  
**Job Description**
**Profile Summary**
A seasoned finance leader with
**deep R2R expertise**
,
**strong accounting judgment**
, and a
**transformation mindset**
, capable of running a
**world-class global R2R operation**
while continuously improving efficiency, controls, and stakeholder confidence.
  
  
As Senior Team Lead for Financial Accounting, you are responsible to ensure a true and fair view on Vanderlande’s financial position and reporting. Together with your team of professionals in Pune, you are responsible for correct, timely, and complete processing of all financial data and general ledger processes. The output forms a substantial part of the process for the Vanderlande monthly financial reports. We need to comply with internal and external regulations (e.g. Tax, internal/external financial reporting, IFRS, J-SOX). Therefor we focus on development and continuous improvement of our financial processes and systems. Main part of your challenge is to prepare and further develop Vanderlande Record to Report (R2R) Business process and your team (Pune) to solid growth amid a continuously changing environment.
  
  
This is a leadership role requiring 17+ years' experience within the R2R domain while managing teams > 30 direct reports of operational team members including SMEs. It requires liaising and working closely with global Business Controllers, Group Financial Control teams. Must have cross-domain expertise and hands-on knowledge of Procure to Pay, Lead to Cash, Fixed Assets, Intercompany and Payroll as well.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Senior R2R Team Leader is accountable for
**end-to-end global Record-to-Report operations**
, ensuring
**financial integrity, governance, compliance, and continuous process excellence**
across multiple geographies.
  
  
The role combines
**deep accounting expertise**
,
**people leadership**
, and
**process transformation capability**
to deliver
**accurate, timely, and insight-driven financial outcomes**
while driving standardization, automation, and maturity of the global R2R landscape.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Global R2R Operations Leadership
* Lead end-to-end R2R processes including

+ General Ledger
+ Month-end and year-end close
+ Balance Sheet Reconciliations
+ Intercompany Accounting & Eliminations
+ Fixed Assets & Leases
+ Journals & Accruals
+ Financial Reporting support

* Own close calendar adherence, accuracy, and completeness across Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
* Ensure zero-surprise balance sheet management and strong financial hygiene.
* Financial Governance & Compliance
* Ensure compliance with IFRS / US GAAP / Local GAAP as applicable.
* Act as key interface for

+ Internal Audit
+ External Audit
+ SOX / JSOX / ICF controls

* Own and continuously strengthen

+ Journal Entry Controls
+ Reconciliation Quality & Aging
+ Manual vs Automated Controls

* Drive closure of audit findings and remediation of control gaps.
* Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement
* Lead Lean, Six Sigma, and digital process improvement initiatives across R2R.
* Reduce close cycle time, manual effort, and rework through

+ Standardization
+ Automation (RPA, AI etc.)
+ Simplification of policies and procedures

* Own R2R KPIs including

+ Close cycle time
+ First-time-right journals
+ Reconciliation aging
+ Audit issues
+ Cost-to-serve

* Transformation & Digital Enablement
* Partner with IT, Digital, and Finance Transformation teams to

+ Implement and optimize ERP platforms
+ Drive tool adoption (Power BI, AI-based reconciliation & anomaly detection)

* Support transition programs

+ GBS migrations
+ Scope expansions

* Stakeholder & Business Partnership
* Act as trusted finance partner to

+ Regional FSSC Heads
+ Business Controllers
+ Global Finance Leadership

* Provide clear, data-backed insights into

+ Balance sheet risks
+ Accounting judgments
+ Process bottlenecks

* Ensure alignment across regions with one global R2R voice.
* People Leadership & Capability Building
* Lead, mentor, and develop a large global R2R team.
* Build strong succession pipelines and future-ready R2R capabilities.
* Drive high employee engagement, accountability, and performance culture.
* Promote a mindset of ownership, continuous learning, and transformation.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**
**Mandatory**

* 17+ years of progressive experience in R2R / Financial Accounting.
* Strong exposure to global operations across Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
* Proven leadership of large teams in GBS / FSSC / Shared Services environments (lead atleast 25+ member team)
* Deep hands-on experience with

+ Month-end close
+ Balance sheet management
+ Intercompany accounting
+ Audit & controls

**Preferred**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) – preferred.
* Lean / Six Sigma / Process Excellence certification.

**Critical Skills & Competencies**
**Technical**

* Expert accounting knowledge (IFRS / GAAP)
* Balance sheet risk assessment & judgment
* Strong control and governance mindset

**Leadership**

* High ownership and accountability
* Strong stakeholder management
* Ability to influence senior finance leadership
* Coaching-oriented people leader

**Transformation**

* Process redesign & standardization
* Automation mindset
* Data-driven decision making

**Success Measures (KPIs)**

* Close cycle time reduction
* Balance sheet aging & cleanliness
* Audit findings (zero high-risk issues)
* Process automation coverage
* Employee engagement & attrition
* Cost-to-serve improvement

**Diversity & Inclusion**
Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: RCM Team Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
Ensures the accurate and timely execution of accounts receivable processes within the Revenue Cycle Services team with the goal of maximizing accounts receivable collections for Veradigm's clients. Executes accounts receivable processes and serves as a subject matter expert for the team to resolve complex accounts receivable issues. Maintains accurate and up-to-date billing records, follows up on outstanding medical billing claims and patient payments, and resolves billing issues. Works closely with other team members to ensure that payments are collected in a timely manner and that financial records are kept in strict compliance with company and client policies and regulations. Assists management in evaluating team members' performance and identifying training needs.
  
  
**Essential Functions/Major Job Responsibilities**

* Promptly responds to internal and external client inquiries, interactions, and requests for information.
* Acts as the initial point of contact for team members regarding technical work questions, processes, and procedures and provides guidance on work matters.
* Escalates issues to RCS Management related to clients and staff.
* Monitors and manages accounts receivable (AR) to ensure timely claim resolution
* Organizes, identifies and improves workflow with team members and management through daily and weekly productivity reports. Escalates challenges, concerns, and needs for assistance to RCS Management.
* Maintains the ability to perform the duties of the Payment Entry Specialist, Charge Entry Specialist, and/or AR Specialist.
* Serves as the team's subject matter expert regarding the claims process, complex claims, AR issues, and claims software.
* Monitors team productivity and generates reports on team performance. Assists management in identifying performance issues.
* Trains new hires and answers questions from less experienced associates.
* Assists with implementing new clients and offboarding client terminations.
* Reconciles account discrepancies by investigating documentation, issuing credit memos, and processing adjustments.
* Maintains accurate financial records and prepares reports on the status of the AR.
* Monitors and reconciles claims, including held vouchers, unbilled vouchers, denial trends, patient balance report, credits, and refunds.
* Effectively handles complex payer denials.
* Processes and pays secondary claims.
* Communicates with clients and medical insurance carriers to resolve billing queries.
* Assists with financial audits by providing necessary documentation and explanations for AR processes.
* Implements process improvements to enhance the efficiency of the AR cycle.

**Benefits**
Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.

title: Senior Estimation Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior Estimation Engineer**

Department : Estimation

Experience : 8+ Years

**Key Responsibilities**

**Estimation & Costing**

• Prepare detailed cost estimates based on approved drawings, specifications, BOQs,

and project requirements.

• Develop project block budgets during the planning and tendering stages.

• Perform detailed quantity take-offs and cost calculations.

• Prepare rate analysis for various construction and engineering activities.

• Maintain and update standard cost databases and estimation norms.

**Budgeting & Cost Control**

• Prepare project budgets and establish cost baselines.

• Conduct budget reconciliation by comparing estimated costs against actual project

expenditures.

• Analyze cost variances and recommend corrective actions.

• Monitor project cost performance and provide periodic MIS reports.

**Value Engineering**

• Identify opportunities for value engineering and cost optimization without

compromising quality and performance.

• Evaluate alternative materials, methods, and design solutions to improve project

profitability.

**Site Coordination**

• Coordinate closely with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Procurement, and Planning

teams.

• Support site teams with budget clarifications, cost analysis, and resource planning.

• Assist in resolving technical and commercial issues related to project costs.

Consumption Analysis & Cost Standards

• Conduct material sampling and study consumption patterns.

• Develop and maintain standard consumption constants for various project activities.

• Analyze productivity and material utilization data to improve estimation accuracy.

**ERP & Systems Management**

• Feed project estimates, budgets, and cost data into the ERP system.

• Maintain estimation records and cost databases within ERP.

• Generate cost reports and project dashboards from ERP systems.

• Ensure accuracy and completeness of cost-related information.

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering

• 5–6 years of relevant experience in estimation, budgeting, and project costing.

• Experience in High-rise Building Project Estimation

**Required Skills**

• Expertise in detailed estimation and quantity take-offs.

• Strong knowledge of rate analysis and cost engineering.

• Experience in block budgeting and project cost control.

• Knowledge of value engineering principles.

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems

• Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and cost analysis tools.

• Strong analytical, communication, and coordination skills.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.

title: BPS Client Service & Support
description:
**Position Type**
Full time
  
  
**Type Of Hire**
Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
  
  
Senior Lead – Collateral Administration
  
  
**About The Team**
The BPS Collateral Administration team, within Capital Markets Managed Services, supports clients in the US and UK. The team provides accounting, transaction processing, cash and position reconciliations, loan administration, portfolio testing, payment calculations, and periodic compliance reporting.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Senior Lead will oversee collateral administration activities for assigned CLO/CDO portfolios and serve as the primary operational contact for clients, trustees, accountants, investment teams, and internal stakeholders. The role is accountable for service delivery, operational controls, team performance, client communication, and reporting across the quarterly lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Client and Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Act as the primary operational contact for assigned clients and maintain effective relationships with trustees, accountants, investment teams, relationship managers, and other stakeholders
* Provide clear updates on service delivery, portfolio activity, client assignments, risks, and issues, including communication with senior and executive stakeholders
* Coordinate effectively with global teams and provide extended coverage during critical reporting periods when required

Operations and Service Delivery

title: Senior Specialist, Payroll
description:
**Job Description**
**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**
The
**Senior Specialist, Payroll Accounting**
is a hands-on role responsible for executing payroll accounting activities across assigned entities. This role prepares journal entries, performs account reconciliations, researches and resolves discrepancies, and completes payroll-related close deliverables accurately and on time. Working closely with Payroll Delivery, Employment Tax, Finance, and other stakeholders, the Senior Specialist applies established controls and procedures in day-to-day work to support compliance, accurate financial reporting, and process efficiency.
  
  
**Payroll Accounting and Close Execution**

* Prepare and post payroll-related journal entries, accruals, reclasses, reversals, and adjustments, with complete supporting documentation.
* Perform day-to-day payroll accounting activities for assigned entities, recording payroll transactions accurately in the general ledger.
* Complete assigned payroll accounting deliverables in line with monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close deadlines.
* Work directly with Payroll Delivery and related teams to resolve discrepancies and clear reconciling items promptly.
* Research reconciling items, out-of-balance conditions, and aged balances, determine root causes, and process the corrections needed to clear them.
* Gather and provide documentation in response to internal and external audit requests.

**General Ledger Reconciliations and Controls**

* Prepare and complete reconciliations for payroll and HR-related balance sheet accounts, including payroll clearing, employment tax liabilities, employee benefit accruals, and benefit-related clearing accounts.
* Complete reconciliations on time with appropriate supporting documentation and clear variance explanations, in line with established financial control standards.
* Review account activity on a recurring basis, flag potential control gaps, and suggest practical process fixes.
* Perform new control steps and complete assigned remediation actions resulting from audits, risk assessments, or operational reviews.

**Reporting, Procedures, and Process Improvement**

* Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports on payroll accounting activities, reconciliations, and close status.
* Follow payroll accounting policies and procedures, and help keep desk procedures and process documentation up to date.
* Compile key metrics and status updates on reconciliation and close progress for management review.
* Complete assigned tasks on special projects, system enhancements, and benefits or compensation-related changes affecting payroll accounting processes, including testing and validation.

**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:**

* A bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance is preferred.
* 5–8 years of total work experience preferred.
* Relevant experience in payroll accounting, general ledger accounting, finance operations, or reconciliation functions preferred.
* Experience performing complex account reconciliations, payroll-related accounting controls and researching accounting discrepancies.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to identify discrepancies and resolve them independently.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis and financial reporting.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across payroll, tax, and finance teams.
* No direct reports.

title: Manager, Energy Market Analyst (Support)
description:

Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.*

**About the Position**

Energy Exemplar is the leader in energy market/system simulation software, with its two platforms: PLEXOS and AURORA. These software platforms have a significant presence in global markets. We are seeking a confident, self-motivated and professional person for the role of
**Manager, Energy Market Analyst**

**Candidate Requirements & Qualifications**

* Ability to articulate the business problem to be analyzed, quickly identify the critical elements of the problem, achieve a high-quality answer in a timely fashion, and synthesize answers to resonate with decision makers.
